title: Recording, mixing: Junior’s Farm, Sally G by Wings | 1974
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

A mixing session for Wings’ single ‘Junior’s Farm’ took place on 30 September 1974.

Two versions of the song existed, the full version and a 3:02 radio edit. Both were remixed on this day, although they were never used, and new mixes were prepared on 7 October.

Also during this session, Paul McCartney re-recorded his lead vocals on the single’s b-side, ‘Sally G’. The song was then mixed in stereo for inclusion on the single.
